content.title: The concept of God
content.description: Follow a Christian–Muslim exchange about God's unity, nature and character.

claim.text: The speakers defend different accounts of God and challenge the other's account. The exchange includes arguments about divine unity and love.

content.hinge: Does the criticism address what the other speaker actually affirms, or a definition the speaker rejects?
prompts: Write down each definition before evaluating it.
Distinguish an objection to coherence from an objection to scriptural support.
Compare the religious passages in their own contexts.

reviews.scope: Structured-document migration and preservation of the 2026-10-05 editorial pass
reviews.note: Compared the compiled documents with the pre-migration website data. Existing text, references, source roles and relationships are preserved. This records migration verification and the prior AI-assisted editorial source pass, not independent human theological approval.
